1309-4875-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
1309-4875-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Conspiracy, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Salvager of Secrets token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2301-4279-6634--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2301-4279-6634--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers, Abzan Ascendancy and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

643-4881-6909-7884.manaNeeded: {1}{W}{U} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
643-4881-6909-7884.description:
Cast Sygg's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

147-413-3905.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-413-3905.description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2511-2577-6664-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2511-2577-6664-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

3861-4913-5310-7857.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, causing you to draw a card and put Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Bloodghast and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Zimone and Dina.
Repeat.

1818-1895-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Healer of the Pride trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1818-1895-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1263-4556-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Rowan, Scholar of Sparks // Will, Scholar of Frost

4499-7494-7644.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.

3617-7487-7631.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Zealous Lorecaster
When the Zealous Lorecaster token enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1115-3259-7603.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that has base power 0.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-3259-7603.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Primo.
Resolve the Primo trigger, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage dealt.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Fractal token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3839-4681-7272.easyPrerequisites: There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard
3839-4681-7272.description:
Cast Changeling Hero by paying {4}{W}.
Changeling Hero enters the battlefield, championing Karmic Guide.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Changeling Hero
Changeling Hero dies, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, returning Changeling Hero from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2084-7202.description:
Cast Kindle the Inner Flame by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, shuffling the token into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1322-1563-3899-4365.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

requires.n: Land with Cycling Cost that can be paid using one colored mana

717-2628-6846--38.description:
Activate the land's cycling ability by paying {1} and discarding it.
When you cycle the land, Escape Protocol and Bone Miser's second ability trigger.
Resolve Bone Miser's ability, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability, paying {1} to blink Vanille.
When Vanille enters, it triggers, milling two cards and returning the cycled land from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, drawing a card.
717-2628-6846--38.notes: You can discard down to maximum hand size at end of turn to trigger Bone Miser's abilities many times.

586-3967-5258-5618-7056.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1414-2423.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Lotus Petal.
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Bounding Krasis.
When Bounding Krasis enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1497-4063-5220-6900.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Fleshtaker trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2842-4905-5220-6900.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

3944-5220-6578-6900.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
3944-5220-6578-6900.notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.

1495-4613-5934-6843.notablePrerequisites: There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
1495-4613-5934-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and The Rollercrusher Ride.
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1887-4636-5491-5770.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating a 6/6 Beast artifact creature token and a Map token.
When the Beast and Map enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat.

1323-4687-5704.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
1323-4687-5704.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Leafkin Avenger's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

2653-5702-5954-6441.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
2653-5702-5954-6441.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
2653-5702-5954-6441.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa each trigger twice.
Resolve both Nissa triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

4222-4720-5390-5516.easyPrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
4222-4720-5390-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
4222-4720-5390-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

488-874-2478-2895-4986.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
One of either Delif's Cone or Mishra's Bauble must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-874-2478-2895-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Uro from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Uro trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to gain 3 life and draw a card, and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

4508-5491-5880-5929.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure and Map token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

413-1349-6012.notablePrerequisites:
There is a coin counter on any creature you control except Athreos.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature if Reluctant Role Model is the only creature you control with a coin counter on it.
413-1349-6012.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Reluctant Role Model's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting a coin counter on it if it wasn't the creature that was sacrificed, or another nontoken creature you control otherwise.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

856-1575-5231-5903.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other artifact.
856-1575-5231-5903.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing another artifact, which is a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, adding {R}.
Repeat.

969-2933-4499-5798.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

648-5042-5757.notablePrerequisites:
Sokrates does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to give a creature haste.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
648-5042-5757.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your eck size.
Give the Fractal token haste, if needed.
Activate Sokrates by tapping it, targeting the Fractal token.
Declare the Fractal token as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block it.
When the Fractal token would deal combat damage, instead prevent that damage. The defending player draws cards equal to the Fractal's power, rounded down, while you will draw double that many cards due to Teferi's Ageless Insight.

849-2034-4144.notablePrerequisites:
It is your upkeep step.
You control at least three artifacts.
849-2034-4144.description:
During your upkeep, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kuldotha Phoenix, adding {C}{C}.
When Kuldotha Phoenix dies, Anax triggers, creating two 1/1 Satyr creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Satyr, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Kuldotha Phoenix by paying {4}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2173-2292-3025-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2354-2530-3862.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Orcish Bowmasters lifelink.
You control at least one additional creature.
2354-2530-3862.description:
If needed, give Orcish Bowmasters lifelink.
Activate Krav by paying {B} and sacrificing all Armies you control, or one other creature if you don't control an Army, causing an opponent to draw a card and gain 1 life for each creature sacrificed this way, and for you to put that many +1/+1 counters on Krav.
Orcish Bowmasters triggers for each card drawn this way, dealing that much damage to any target and causing you to gain that much life, then creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and put a +1/+1 counter on it for each card drawn.
When the Orc Army enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat from step 2.

57-232-2178-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon.
Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
57-232-2178-5231.description:
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask, adding {R}.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Feldon triggers, untapping Feldon.
Repeat.

732-914-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Felhide Spiritbinder.
Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
732-914-4222.description:
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping Felhide Spiritbinder.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Felhide Spiritbinder.
Felhide Spiritbinder triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
The token Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}{U}{R}.
Repeat.

2060-4772-5105-5256.manaNeeded: {4} in at least three different colors
2060-4772-5105-5256.description:
Cast Crystalline Crawler giving it six +1/+1 counters because of Doubling Season.
Remove all six counters getting {W} {W} {U} {B} {R} {G}.
Sacrifice Crawler to Altar milling target player 1.
Pay Sigil's cost of {1}{W} returning Crawler to hand.
Recast Crystalline Crawler for all but one of the remaining floating mana giving it eight +1/+1 counters.
Remove all eight counters netting {8} of assorted colors containing at least {W} {W} {U} {B} {R} {G}.
Repeat steps 4-7.

2445-3921-4929-5189.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least three +1/+1 counters.
2445-3921-4929-5189.description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Cryptic Trilobite, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling token, putting four +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Repeat.
